title: Person
description: One person who started, shaped or spread a style. The people layer puts a life next to the time line of the styles. Facts come from open data (Wikidata, Wikimedia Commons); the bio and the milestones are our own words.

born.description: Year of birth. Null when no open source gives it. Do not guess a year.

died.description: Year of death. Null for a living person, or when no open source gives it.

styles.description: The styles this person is tied to. The first one is the style the person is filed under on the time line: its domain is the lane. Empty is permitted for a person who works across styles (a trend-setter from a source with no style match yet).

role.description: founder: started the style. key-figure: made its canonical works. forerunner: came before it and prepared it. populariser: made it common. trend-setter: set a current trend inside it. rebel: led the turn away from it. patron: paid for it, commissioned it or invested in it. artisan: made its objects by hand or by machine for others (a cabinetmaker, a printer, a type founder, a colourist). Each role is in one of four classes (rule 2 of the curation rules): pioneer = founder, forerunner; artisan = key-figure, artisan; influencer = populariser, trend-setter, rebel; patron = patron.

milestones.description: Dated events that put the person on the time line. Simple past tense, one event each.

posthumous.description: Set it on an event after the year of death (a building completed or a chapel opened after the person died). A milestone after died without it is an error.

photo.description: A portrait on Wikimedia Commons, linked, not copied. Null when Commons has no free portrait.

url.description: A thumbnail URL on the Commons server.

found_in.description: Where we found this person (a video, a list, an article), when that is not one of the sources.
